question: A person who loves all mankind / Someone who freely gives money and help to people who need it
explanation: Philanthropist means “मानव प्रेमी, परोपकारी”. Example: The philanthropist donated millions to build schools for poor children.

question: An inscription on a tombstone in the memory of the person who has died
explanation: Epitaph means “समाधि-लेख”. Example: The epitaph on the tombstone praised the man's kindness.

question: Something no longer in use
explanation: Obsolete means “अप्रचलित”. Example: This technology has become obsolete after the introduction of modern devices.

question: Handwriting which is difficult or impossible to read
explanation: Illegible means “अपठनीय”. Example: The doctor's handwriting was so illegible that I could not read the prescription.

question: Something that cannot be avoided / Certain to happen
explanation: Inevitable means “अटल / जिसे टाला न जा सके”. Example: Change is inevitable in every growing organisation.

question: A place for keeping birds in a confined space
explanation: Aviary means “पक्षीशाला / चिड़ियाघर”. Example: The zoo has a large aviary for exotic birds.

question: Belonging to the same time / A person living in the same age with another
explanation: Contemporary means “समकालीन”. Example: Shakespeare was a contemporary of Queen Elizabeth I.

question: A person who can endure pain or hardship without showing feelings or complaining
explanation: Stoic means “सहनशील / भावनाओं को नियंत्रित रखने वाला”. Example: The soldier remained stoic despite his severe injuries.

question: One who doesn't believe in the existence of God
explanation: Atheist means “नास्तिक”. Example: The atheist did not believe in the existence of any god.

question: A person who draws or makes maps
explanation: Cartographer means “मानचित्रकार”. Example: The cartographer prepared a detailed map of the region.

question: An extreme fear of being in a small confined place
explanation: Claustrophobia means “छोटी जगह में होने का अत्यधिक डर”. Example: He avoided the lift because he suffered from claustrophobia.

question: One who knows everything
explanation: Omniscient means “सर्वज्ञानी”. Example: In the story, the narrator is omniscient and knows every character's thoughts.

question: A solution for all difficulties or diseases
explanation: Panacea means “हर समस्या या रोग का रामबाण इलाज”. Example: There is no single panacea for all social problems.

question: A person who knows and is able to use several languages
explanation: Polyglot means “बहुभाषी व्यक्ति”. Example: The polyglot can communicate fluently in several languages.

question: An arrangement of events or dates in the order of their occurrence
explanation: Chronology means “कालक्रम”. Example: The textbook presents the historical events in chronological order.

question: A speech or a presentation made without previous preparation
explanation: Extempore means “बिना तैयारी के”. Example: The candidate gave an impressive extempore speech.

question: One who is difficult to please
explanation: Fastidious means “नखरेबाज / बहुत चुस्त या चयनशील”. Example: He is fastidious about the quality of the food he eats.

question: An imagined society where everything is perfect and everyone is happy / A place of ideal perfection especially in laws, government, and social conditions
explanation: Utopia means “आदर्शवादी काल्पनिक समाज/राज्य”. Example: The novel describes a utopia where everyone lives peacefully and equally.

question: One who plays for pleasure rather than as a profession / A person who is neither well experienced nor professional
explanation: Amateur means “शौकीन / अनुभवहीन गैर-पेशेवर”. Example: He is an amateur photographer who takes pictures as a hobby.

question: Able to use the left hand and right hand equally well
explanation: Ambidextrous means “उभयहस्त / दोनों हाथों से समान रूप से काम करने वाला”. Example: The ambidextrous player can throw with either hand.

question: A person who attacks or criticizes cherished beliefs or institutions
explanation: Iconoclast means “रिवाज/मान्यताओं को तोड़ने वाला”. Example: The iconoclast openly challenged several traditional beliefs.

question: One who cannot make mistake
explanation: Infallible means “अचूक / जिससे गलती न हो”. Example: No human being is completely infallible.

question: Someone who makes charitable donations intended to the welfare of other people
explanation: Altruist means “परोपकारी”. Example: The altruist devoted his wealth to helping poor families.

question: The place where public, government or historical records are kept
explanation: Archive means “अभिलेखागार”. Example: The researcher visited the national archive to study old government records.

question: A person who loves or collects books
explanation: Bibliophile means “पुस्तक प्रेमी”. Example: The bibliophile has a large collection of rare books.

question: The murder of a whole race or a group of people
explanation: Genocide means “नरसंहार”. Example: The international community condemned the genocide of the ethnic population.

question: A sound that cannot be heard
explanation: Inaudible means “अश्रव्य / जिसे सुना न जा सके”. Example: His voice became inaudible because of the loud noise.

question: One who cannot be corrected / One who is beyond reform
explanation: Incorrigible means “असंशोधनीय / जिसे सुधारा न जा सके”. Example: The teacher considered the repeatedly disobedient boy incorrigible.

question: A person who writes and edits dictionaries
explanation: Lexicographer means “शब्दकोश का लेखक”. Example: The lexicographer spent years compiling the new dictionary.

question: Someone working or acting merely for money or other rewards / A soldier who fights for the sake of money
explanation: Mercenary means “किराये का सैनिक / धन के लिए काम करने वाला”. Example: The king hired mercenary soldiers to fight in the war.

question: A person who hates and avoids other people
explanation: Misanthrope means “मानवद्वेषी”. Example: The old man was considered a misanthrope because he avoided society.

question: Sentimental longing for a period in the past
explanation: Nostalgia means “अतीत की घटनाओं की यादें”. Example: The old photographs filled her with nostalgia for her childhood.

question: Animal that can live both on land and in water
explanation: Amphibian means “उभयचर जन्तु”. Example: A frog is an amphibian that can live both on land and in water.

question: The life history of a person written by himself
explanation: Autobiography means “आत्मकथा”. Example: The leader wrote an autobiography describing his childhood and political career.

question: A person who eats human flesh
explanation: Cannibal means “नरभक्षक”. Example: The historical account described the tribe as cannibals.

question: A person employed to drive a private or hired car
explanation: Chauffeur means “मोटर-चालक”. Example: The businessman hired a chauffeur to drive his private car.

question: The scientific study of worms and insects
explanation: Entomology means “कीटविज्ञान”. Example: She studied entomology to understand the behaviour of insects.

question: One who is unable to pay debts
explanation: Insolvent means “दिवालिया / ऋण चुकाने में असमर्थ”. Example: The company became insolvent after years of financial losses.

question: A person with strong desire to steal
explanation: Kleptomaniac means “चोरी करने की बीमारी से पीड़ित व्यक्ति”. Example: The kleptomaniac had an uncontrollable urge to steal small objects.

question: Government or rule by a small group of people
explanation: Oligarchy means “अल्पतंत्र / कुछ लोगों का शासन”. Example: The country was ruled by an oligarchy of powerful families.

question: One who is all powerful
explanation: Omnipotent means “सर्वशक्तिमान”. Example: The ancient people believed their god to be omnipotent.

question: A person who collects or studies stamps
explanation: Philatelist means “डाक के टिकट का संग्रहकर्ता”. Example: The philatelist owns a rare collection of Indian stamps.

question: A person who never takes alcoholic drinks
explanation: Teetotaller means “पूर्णतः मद्यत्यागी”. Example: He is a teetotaller and never drinks alcohol.

question: Someone having many skills
explanation: Versatile means “सर्वगुण सम्पन्न / अनेक कौशल वाला”. Example: She is a versatile artist who can sing, dance and paint.

question: A person who believes that laws and governments are not necessary / A person who believes in or tries to bring about a state of lawlessness
explanation: Anarchist means “अराजकतावादी”. Example: The anarchist opposed the existence of a central government.

question: The art of beautiful handwriting
explanation: Calligraphy means “सुलेख”. Example: She learned calligraphy to improve her handwriting.

question: A group of stars that forms a shape in the sky and has a name
explanation: Constellation means “नक्षत्र”. Example: Orion is a well-known constellation visible in the night sky.

question: An animal that lives in groups / Tending to associate with others of one's kind
explanation: Gregarious means “झुंड में रहने वाला / मिलनसार”. Example: Elephants are gregarious animals that live in herds.

question: A quiet person who is more interested in his own thoughts and feelings than in spending time with other people
explanation: Introvert means “अंतर्मुखी व्यक्ति”. Example: The introvert preferred reading alone rather than attending large social gatherings.

question: A piece of land/garden in which fruit trees are grown
explanation: Orchard means “फलोद्यान”. Example: The farmer owns a large mango orchard.

question: Fit to drink (water)
explanation: Potable means “पीने योग्य”. Example: The village finally received a supply of clean potable water.

question: A person who helps another to commit a crime or to do something morally wrong / A partner in crime
explanation: Accomplice means “सह-अपराधी”. Example: The police arrested the thief and his accomplice.

question: One who is not sure about God's existence
explanation: Agnostic means “ईश्वर के बारे में संशयवादी व्यक्ति”. Example: The agnostic said that he was uncertain whether God exists.

question: A partial or total loss of memory
explanation: Amnesia means “भूलने की बीमारी / स्मृतिलोप”. Example: The accident left the patient suffering from partial amnesia.

question: A situation in a country, an organization, etc. in which there is no government, order or control
explanation: Anarchy means “अव्यवस्था / अराजकता”. Example: The sudden collapse of the government led to a period of anarchy.

question: A person who regards the whole world as his country / One who is a citizen of not a country but of the world
explanation: Cosmopolitan means “समस्त संसार का नागरिक”. Example: A cosmopolitan person is comfortable living among people from different cultures.

question: A person who leaves his country to live in another
explanation: Emigrant means “अपने देश को छोड़कर दूसरे देश में जाने वाला”. Example: The emigrant left India to settle permanently in Canada.

question: Lasting for a very short time
explanation: Ephemeral means “क्षणिक / बहुत कम समय तक रहने वाला”. Example: Fame on social media can be ephemeral.

question: To free somebody from all blame
explanation: Exonerate means “दोषमुक्त करना”. Example: New evidence helped exonerate the accused man.

question: One who is easily deceived
explanation: Gullible means “भोला-भाला / आसानी से धोखा खाने वाला”. Example: The gullible man believed the fake investment offer.

question: Holding an office without receiving a pay
explanation: Honorary means “अवैतनिक”. Example: He was appointed honorary chairman without receiving a salary.

question: A person who suffers from an imaginary illness / A person who is abnormally anxious about his health
explanation: Hypochondriac means “रोगभ्रमी”. Example: The hypochondriac constantly worried that minor symptoms were signs of serious diseases.

question: A person pretending to be somebody he isn't
explanation: Hypocrite means “पाखंडी”. Example: A hypocrite often pretends to have moral standards that he does not follow himself.

question: That which cannot be conquered
explanation: Invincible means “अजेय”. Example: The team appeared invincible after winning every match.

question: A place where money is coined by authority of the government
explanation: Mint means “टकसाल”. Example: The coins were produced at the government mint.

question: A person who admires himself/herself too much, especially his appearance
explanation: Narcissist means “आत्ममोहित व्यक्ति”. Example: The narcissist spent hours admiring himself in the mirror.

question: Well-known for being bad / A person of evil reputation
explanation: Notorious means “कुख्यात”. Example: The city was once notorious for its high crime rate.

question: A person who collects coins
explanation: Numismatist means “मुद्राशास्त्री / सिक्कों का संग्रहकर्ता”. Example: The numismatist displayed a collection of ancient coins.

question: A large number of fish swimming together
explanation: Shoal means “मछलियों का समुदाय”. Example: A large shoal of fish was visible near the shore.

question: A place where bees are kept
explanation: Apiary means “मधुमक्खियों के पालन का स्थान”. Example: The farmer keeps hundreds of bee colonies in his apiary.

question: A military structure where arms and ammunition and other military equipment are stored
explanation: Arsenal means “शस्त्रागार”. Example: The army stored its weapons and ammunition in the arsenal.

question: The story of a person's life written by somebody else
explanation: Biography means “जीवनी”. Example: She wrote a biography of the famous freedom fighter.

question: House or shelter of a gipsy / A group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, travelling together across a desert
explanation: Caravan means “काफिला”. Example: A caravan of traders crossed the desert.

question: A man who knows a lot about things like food, music and art
explanation: Connoisseur means “विशेषज्ञ / पारखी”. Example: He is a connoisseur of classical music and fine art.

question: Man behaving more like a woman than as a man
explanation: Effeminate means “नारी जैसा”. Example: The character was portrayed as effeminate in his mannerisms and dress.

question: A poem that expresses lament for the dead
explanation: Elegy means “शोकगीत”. Example: The poet wrote an elegy in memory of his departed friend.

question: A short speech at the end of a play
explanation: Epilogue means “उपसंहार”. Example: The narrator delivered an epilogue at the end of the play.

question: A person who believes that all events are predetermined or subject to fate
explanation: Fatalist means “भाग्यवादी”. Example: The fatalist believed that everything in life was already determined by fate.

question: A person who sells and arranges cut flowers
explanation: Florist means “फूलवाला”. Example: I bought a bouquet from the local florist.

question: Extreme fear of water
explanation: Hydrophobia means “पानी का डर”. Example: The patient developed hydrophobia after a traumatic experience in water.

question: A plan of a journey, including the route and the places that will be visited
explanation: Itinerary means “यात्रा कार्यक्रम”. Example: The travel agent prepared a detailed itinerary for our trip.

question: A copy of a book, piece of music, etc. before it has been printed / A paper written by hand
explanation: Manuscript means “हस्तलिखित”. Example: The author submitted the manuscript of his new novel to the publisher.

question: A person who dislikes women
explanation: Misogynist means “स्त्रीद्वेषी”. Example: His misogynist remarks were strongly criticised by the audience.

question: A person who walks on foot and not travelling in a vehicle
explanation: Pedestrian means “पैदल यात्री”. Example: Pedestrians should use the footpath while walking on busy roads.

question: A person who always expects bad things to happen or something not to be successful
explanation: Pessimist means “निराशावादी”. Example: The pessimist expected the project to fail despite the positive results.

question: Occurring or coming into existence after a person's death
explanation: Posthumous means “मरणोपरांत”. Example: The author's posthumous novel was published two years after his death.

question: The murder of a king
explanation: Regicide means “राज-हत्या”. Example: The conspirators were accused of regicide after the king was murdered.

question: Someone who walks about in sleep
explanation: Somnambulist means “नींद में चलने वाला”. Example: The somnambulist sometimes walked around the house while asleep.

question: The scientific study of sound
explanation: Acoustics means “ध्वनि-विज्ञान”. Example: The engineer studied acoustics to improve the design of the concert hall.

question: The money paid to former wife, husband or partner when the marriage is ended
explanation: Alimony means “गुजारा भत्ता”. Example: The court ordered him to pay alimony to his former wife.

question: The study of the human race, especially of its origin, development, customs and beliefs
explanation: Anthropology means “मानव विज्ञान”. Example: Anthropology helps us understand the origin and development of human societies.

question: A glass tank where fish and water plants are kept
explanation: Aquarium means “मछलीघर”. Example: The children watched colourful fish swimming in the aquarium.

question: A person who is chosen to settle a disagreement / A person appointed by two parties to resolve a dispute
explanation: Arbitrator means “पंच / मध्यस्थ”. Example: The two companies appointed an arbitrator to settle their dispute.

question: The study of human history and prehistory through the excavation of sites
explanation: Archaeology means “पुरातत्व विज्ञान”. Example: Archaeology helps researchers learn about ancient civilisations through excavated remains.

question: A government by the nobles / government by persons of the highest social order
explanation: Aristocracy means “कुलीन वर्ग द्वारा शासन”. Example: In an aristocracy, political power is traditionally held by members of the noble class.

question: Hard but easily broken / liable to break easily
explanation: Brittle means “भंगुर / आसानी से टूटने योग्य”. Example: Glass is hard but brittle and can break easily.

question: An assembly of worshippers / A group of people who have come together in a religious building for worship or prayer
explanation: Congregation means “धार्मिक सभा”. Example: The congregation gathered in the church for Sunday prayer.

question: A keeper or custodian of a museum or other collection
explanation: Curator means “संग्रहालय अध्यक्ष / संग्रह का प्रभारी”. Example: The curator arranged the ancient artefacts in the museum.

question: The scientific study of skin diseases
explanation: Dermatology means “त्वचाविज्ञान”. Example: Dermatology deals with diseases and conditions affecting the skin.

question: Causing or ending in death
explanation: Fatal means “घातक”. Example: The accident caused a fatal injury to the passenger.

question: One who eats too much
explanation: Glutton means “खाऊ / पेटू”. Example: The glutton ate far more food than anyone else at the party.

question: A person who cannot read or write
explanation: Illiterate means “अनपढ़”. Example: The campaign aims to teach every illiterate adult to read and write.

question: The condition of being unable to sleep over a period of time
explanation: Insomnia means “अनिद्रा”. Example: Stress can cause insomnia and make it difficult to sleep at night.

question: A person who supervises during an examination
explanation: Invigilator means “निरीक्षक”. Example: The invigilator instructed the candidates to keep their phones outside the examination hall.

question: That through which light cannot pass
explanation: Opaque means “अपारदर्शी”. Example: Wood is an opaque material through which light cannot pass.

question: Violation of something holy or sacred
explanation: Sacrilege means “अपवित्रीकरण / पवित्र वस्तु का अनादर”. Example: Damaging the sacred monument was considered an act of sacrilege.

question: A speech made to oneself
explanation: Soliloquy means “आत्मभाषण”. Example: The actor delivered a powerful soliloquy while expressing his inner thoughts.

question: One who lends money on high rates of interest
explanation: Usurer means “सूदखोर”. Example: The poor farmer borrowed money from a usurer at a very high interest rate.

question: One who offers one's services without being forced
explanation: Volunteer means “स्वयंसेवक”. Example: Many volunteers offered their services during the flood relief operation.

question: To give up one's authority or throne
explanation: Abdicate means “अपना पद या ताज छोड़ देना”. Example: The king decided to abdicate the throne in favour of his son.

question: A publication containing astronomical or meteorological annual calendar that contains important dates and time
explanation: Almanac means “पंचांग / वार्षिक संदर्भ-पुस्तक”. Example: The farmer consulted the almanac for astronomical and weather information.
